title: Chapter 24: Making The Best Of A Bad Situation And Harvesting Crops
content:
Chapter 24: Making The Best Of A Bad Situation And Harvesting Crops

Wu Qing was inertial in his thinking, and he did not think for a moment that the people in this territory were all tenants and farmhands of the lord, and they all worked for the lord. What kind of work-for-relief is superfluous.

This is a nice way of saying it.

To put it another way, all the people are the lord's slaves. If the lord wants them to die, they have to die obediently.

They are slaves sold to Wu Qing by their master. Even if Wu Qing kills them all, he guarantees that no one will cause him any trouble.

This world is so cruel. Without the protection of the lord, it is impossible to survive.

"So that's the situation. Then just tell them to work? I have the final say on whether to pay them or not?"

"No, no, I guess we'll have to use supervisors to supervise their work. Most people here are just waiting to die, and they may not be afraid of death. Threats are useless."

"Since the work-for-relief order has been issued, let's make the best of it and start reforming the Great Xia Territory from here."

"The territory will definitely become stronger and stronger. Even in another world, it must live up to the name of Great Xia."

After making a decision, Wu Qing asked the Queen of Insects to continue explaining to the residents of the territory.

"All the work that was originally responsible for will be registered uniformly."

"After all the work is planned in a coordinated manner, it will be uniformly distributed."

"In the future, the remuneration standards for daily work will be set according to the nature and intensity of the work, and the settlement will be made every day."

"The remuneration will be settled in grain for the time being."

This is the first change Wu Qing brought to the Great Xia Territory. Distribution according to work, real-time settlement, and improving everyone's enthusiasm for work.

If you want to eat enough, you have to work harder.

Originally, these people were to be supported by the lord. Now, they have changed their ways to allow those who are willing to pay to live a better life, which may give them a glimmer of hope in life.

As for those who continue to mess around, Wu Qing doesn't care about them.

What people fear most is comparison. When others live better than him, he may suddenly figure it out and stop lying down and get up obediently.

When this explanation came out, everyone was very surprised.

"Everyday settlement of food? Is it such a good thing? As long as you work, you can eat enough every day?"

"Where does the food come from? There is no food in the city for a long time!"

"No matter what, there is always hope. Maybe the new lord has food in his hands?"

"Then go register first! See where to register?"

"..."

No matter what everyone thinks, the lord's order cannot be disobeyed. What needs to be done now is to register the work that everyone is responsible for every day.

The people recruited by Wu Qing through the recruitment order are now useful. Under the guidance of the Queen of Insects, they have learned to use identity cards to record the information told by others.

The total population of more than 2,000 people, excluding the elderly and children who cannot work, is actually not that many people.

Most of the young and strong people in this city were defeated by the previous lord.

The puppy appeared to maintain order, and 20 teams were lined up. It didn't take much time to complete the registration.

When registering, you only need to verbally report your name, age, family situation, physical health, work you are good at, and the work you are currently responsible for.

The Queen of Insects analyzes the registered information and re-plans and arranges the work based on the number of people required for various existing tasks in the territory.

Those who are good at taking care of the fields will take care of the fields; those who are good at cleaning will be responsible for cleaning up the garbage in the city; those who are good at picking hemp, weaving cloth, and making clothes will be responsible for the supply of clothes;

and so on.

There are also specific rules for everyone's daily working hours and work tasks, and every aspect is carefully considered.

Today, the Queen of Insects prioritized the work that must be done every day, such as the management of the fields and the work of ensuring basic life in the city, so that professionals can lead the least labor to do these things.

The rest of the people are arranged to pick and carry food in the wild.

The Queen of Zerg used the host to transmit information to individuals with her spirit, and directly arranged everyone's work in place.

"I'm going to take care of the fields with the old goat today!"

"I'm assigned to pick and carry food! I'm going to the wild with the Zerg warriors!"

"I want to go to the wild too!"

"Me too!"

"Me too!"

"..."

Most people's work today was assigned to pick and carry food in the wild.

"There is a lot of food in the wild, but you have to pay with your life!"

"What are you afraid of? Isn't there a Zerg army?"

"It's hard to guard against the weird!"

"Didn't you see that the Zerg army went out to fight the weird at night? What are you afraid of in broad daylight?"

"..."

The residents of the territory generally had no resistance to this arrangement to go to the wild, which was much better than Wu Qing expected.

Wu Qing also transferred some puppies, hydralisks and hosts from the Zerg territory. Each host led 8 puppies and 2 hydralisks to form a team and led a team of territory residents to the wild.

The residents of the territory, regardless of gender, age or ability to work, followed. The strong pushed the wheelbarrows, and the weak carried various backpacks, baskets and sacks.

Almost all the people in the city went out and marched into the wild.

The large number of Zerg combat troops rushing out in front of them was the source of their confidence.

"Since the Zerg are not afraid, why should we be afraid of our own lives?"

This is the voice of many people.

Hu Tu followed the team and observed, learned and practiced under the guidance of the Queen of Zerg.

The 20 identity card binders also took on their responsibilities under the guidance of the Queen of Insects.

Crossing the fields and walking out of the territory protected by the lord, everyone was replaced by great joy before they had time to be nervous.

First, they entered the wild puppy and kept catching various edible animals, some dead, some half-dead, and bloody.

Everyone was not afraid at all, only endless joy!

"How long have we not eaten meat?!"

An old cat asked tremblingly, asking everyone's dilemma.

"Come and help deal with it! The prey is limited, and it will run away when it hears the noise. Finish it first, and then we will pick food!"

Hu Tu shouted in the crowd.

"The lord said! Everyone will have meat to eat tonight! Come on!"

Hearing that there is meat to eat, everyone started to work happily.

Some people carried it, some slaughtered it, and some people have already started to transport the prey to the city.

The killing efficiency of the Zerg was very high. After a while, all the suitable prey in this wild area was hunted by them.

After harvesting a large amount of meat, everyone was more motivated. Women, the elderly, and children were already picking ripe fruits from the fruit trees in the wild.

Wild vegetables, fruits, edible seeds, rhizomes, as long as they were edible, everyone had to scrape the ground three feet to collect them and transport them to the city.

The hungry children picked the fruits that could be eaten directly and ate them in big mouthfuls, splashing the juice.

Everyone swallowed their saliva and looked in the direction of Hu Tu. Hu Tu represented the lord, and these things belonged to the lord and could not be eaten casually.

"Everyone, eat as much as you want! Don't eat too much! We still have to work!"

At the instruction of the Queen of the Zerg, Hu Tu shouted loudly.

Everyone cheered and started to stuff all the edible things into their mouths.

The feeling of being hungry is really uncomfortable!

After a busy day, the Great Xia Territory harvested a lot of meat and other food.

Because the wild areas we went to today were the closest to the city, the efficiency was very high. The food we harvested this day, if we eat it sparingly, is enough for the people in this city to eat for several months.

The food in the Daxia territory became sufficient, and people's hearts began to settle down. Wu Qing felt that the fortune of the territory began to increase slightly.
